prompts.court: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original cinematic environment plate for an animated historical film, 16:9 wide. Scene: Qing China circa 1840, imperial study at night, camera looking obliquely down onto a broad dark worn hardwood desk. Empty center two thirds of desk, absolutely no papers or writing in center (animated memorial will be composited there). On far right edge a small inkstone and understated brush rest; soft candle glow outside left frame. Background upper fifth distant wooden lattice window in deep blue night, blurred. Beautiful realistic subtle worn wood grain, cool moonlight falling diagonally from rear right, muted amber raking light across desk. Cinematography 50mm lens, rich but legible shadows, restrained film grain, realistic light falloff and depth, tactile materials. No people, no modern items, no readable text, no seals, no scrolls, no UI, no border, no title. This is an artistic historical visualization, not a documentary photograph. High quality film production design, not a videogame render. Keep tabletop center clear and relatively evenly lit for composited paper.
prompts.courier: Use case historical-scene. Cinematic original environment plate for animated Chinese history film set circa 1840, 16:9 widescreen. Rainy Qing era postal relay courtyard at blue hour. View from beneath deep shadowed wooden eaves, looking along wet flagstones towards an open wooden gateway, small distant courier silhouette and horse beyond gateway, no close people. Left foreground dark wooden pillar frames the shot, right middle ground warm lantern under the eaves, tiled low roof, plaster worn from rain, puddles reflect warm lantern and cool sky. Strong depth, photographic realism, beautiful restrained cinematography, muted desaturated indigo slate with little amber. No falling rain painted as large streaks (rain will be animated separately), no text or logos, no modern objects, not a fantasy palace. Clear space bottom center for a foreground delivery packet animation. Historical visualization, not a photo claiming an actual event.
prompts.river: Use case historical-scene. Asset type cinematic environment plate for historical animated film, 16:9 widescreen. Original artistic reconstruction of a broad LOWER YANGTZE river bank in China circa 1842. Photographic cinematic realism, restrained painterly matte painting finish. Camera low from a quiet stone and weathered timber landing, left foreground dark mooring stakes and a few reeds, middle distance clustered modest whitewashed walls and dark tiled roofs following irregular low bank, a credible low city wall receding far away rather than dominating. Wide river occupies lower half and opens to right, faint sandy shoals in distance, far hills in silver mist very far away. No giant mountains next to shore. Distant small traditional Chinese sailing junks for scale, no large ships in foreground. Gentle clouded dawn, muted grey-green water, beautiful haze separating five depth planes. Slight amber trace on wet timber, no golden fantasy sunset. Empty water across center-right for composited animated passing vessel. No text, no logos, no UI, no modern buildings. Film production design, not low polygon, not game concept splash art.
